pause_target: Only child.pid from the directly created Popen object; each child starts its own session.
cleanup_scope: Only the isolated child process group; SIGKILL is in the exception path, which did not execute in these six samples.
numeric_pid_limit: The original runner did not persist numeric PIDs for completed children. These cannot be supplied retrospectively; no rerun was done to manufacture them. Ownership is established by the unchanged runner source and normal completion records.
shared_host_load_limit: Native compilation used two jobs alongside the parent gate. Shared host load is a possible scheduling variable; the signal fault targets only its own child.
